agent_identity.purpose: Parse natural language admission requirements into structured criteria

task_instructions.primary_task: Convert unstructured requirement text into structured entries

examples.input: Minimum GPA of 3.5 on a 4.0 scale
Recommended: 2 years of work experience in tech

constraints: Mark requirements with 'Recommended' or 'Preferred' as is_mandatory=false
All other requirements default to is_mandatory=true
Preserve the original phrasing in the value field

requirements.type: enum (min_gpa, prerequisite_course, language_test, work_experience, research_experience, other)
